name: paw-pbe-sto-1
radial_convention: R(r) = sum_p c_p N_p r^(n_p-1) exp(-zeta_p r), N_p = (2 zeta_p)^(n_p+1/2) / sqrt((2 n_p)!)

pbefit.method: STO shells fitted to VASP PBE free-atom PAW orbitals; frozen method of tools/basisfit (docs/BASIS_FIT_PLAN.md, M3 2026-11-06)
pbefit.koga_base: shells without a 'fit' block are the Koga HF STOs described above
pbefit.note: mode 2026, atoms boxrule, rule 2026, extras auto

atom_settings.code: VASP, gamma-only, one atom in a cubic box (20 A; 24 A by the box rule)
atom_settings.basis: ENCUT max(400, 1.3 ENMAX) eV rounded up to 10 eV, PREC Accurate, LREAL .FALSE., ISYM 0
atom_settings.scf: EDIFF 1e-7; setting A: ALGO Normal, NELM 60; setting B (only if A fails): ALGO All, NELM 250
atom_settings.box_rule: 24 A box if a fitted shell is bound by less than 1 eV in the 20 A box
